name: @projexlight/service-lineage-projector
summary: Cross-pool lineage projector service (G8 closer) — backs sdk-lineage. Pulls lineage events from every per-tenant pool, projects them into the global lineage graph, and runs backfills when new pool families attach. Handles the Iceberg REST catalog binding too — lineage rows reference Iceberg snapshots when sdk-analytics + connector-snowflake are present.

events.name: lineage-projector.batch.committed.v1
events.description: Projector pass finished; carries nodes/edges processed.

events.name: lineage-projector.iceberg.bound.v1
events.description: Lineage node bound to an Iceberg snapshot ref (analytics tier).

hooks.name: startProjector
hooks.description: Background worker — pulls lineage inbox + writes projection rows.

hooks.name: backfillPoolFamily
hooks.description: Backfill lineage for a newly attached pool family.

hooks.name: bindIcebergSnapshot
hooks.description: Bind a lineage node to an Iceberg snapshot ref (analytics).

scenarios.title: Start projector; project lineage rows in batches
scenarios.example_code:
import { startProjector } from '@projexlight/service-lineage-projector';
await startProjector({ interval_ms: 5000 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Per-tick batch projects lineage rows. Emits .batch.committed.v1.

scenarios.title: Bind lineage node to Iceberg snapshot for analytics
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on analytics.lakehouse.extracted.v1 — bind the source lineage node to the resulting Iceberg snapshot ref.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Lineage rows carry the snapshot ref; queryDownstream can follow into the lakehouse.

scenarios.title: New pool family attached → backfill lineage
scenarios.when_to_use: When pool-federation-runtime adds a new pool family, this service backfills its lineage so cross-pool queries see complete provenance.
scenarios.example_code:
import { backfillPoolFamily } from '@projexlight/service-lineage-projector';
await backfillPoolFamily({ pool_family: 'eu-west-app-2' });
scenarios.expected_outcome: All historic lineage from the pool projected. Idempotent on (pool, checkpoint).

scenarios.title: Vault key shred propagates lineage tombstones
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive: shred event → tombstone every lineage node encrypted under that key.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Downstream sdk-lineage queries see dead-ends with proper attribution to the shred event.

scenarios.title: Lag alarm
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbox depth > threshold for > 5 min; on-call paged.

compliance_posture.notes: Cross-pool projection guarantees federated analytics queries see complete provenance. Iceberg snapshot bindings let the regulator replay 'what data + which transformation produced this number'.
